sources.evidence: The recipe supplies this fixed gnulib checkout to libiconv autogen.sh. Imported runtime objects are archived as srclib/libicrt.a and linked only into the dependency's iconv command, while FFmpeg links lib/libiconv.a. BtbN does not copy the dependency command into its FFmpeg archive, so the remaining copied scripts, M4 macros, and build helpers are build-only.
The recipe builds and installs the static OpenCL ICD Loader from SCRIPT_REPO2.
Vulkan-Headers from SCRIPT_REPO2 supplies headers to the built Vulkan shim loader.
The fixed FFmpeg 8.1 add-in satisfies FFVER <= 801, so the recipe does not install the default ffnvcodec checkout.
The fixed FFmpeg 8.1 add-in satisfies FFVER <= 801 and installs the sdk/13.0 checkout from SCRIPT_REPO2.
SCRIPT_REPO3 is installed only when FFVER < 800; the fixed add-in is 8.1.

Opus autogen.sh downloads and extracts the archive identified by this SHA-256, but the fixed BtbN recipe does not enable DRED, Deep PLC, or OSCE and disables extra programs. The downloaded model and generated DNN sources are therefore not compiled or installed.
